name: ceo-thread-orchestrator
description: CEO Flow: a Codex CEO/PM orchestration skill for turning PRDs into lightweight Core Team execution with result harvest, specialist lanes, compact memory/history providers, neutral review gates, and unattended command planning.

interface.shortDescription: CEO-style Codex workflow across expert lanes.
interface.longDescription: Coordinate Codex work as a CEO/PM/architect: keep one decision lane, turn accepted PRDs/task graphs into Core Team execution, route bounded implementation/review/product/knowledge roles when tools allow it, plan unattended-safe approvals, harvest worker results, use compact source-backed memory/history providers when configured, keep neutral review gates, reuse lanes, maintain rosters/evidence cards, and scale threads only when the task graph justifies it.
defaultPrompt: Use CEO Flow for this project.
Execute this PRD with the CEO Flow Core Team.
Plan an unattended CEO Flow execution wave.
Run a neutral evidence-first review gate.
Use compact memory/history provider context if configured.
Split this work into reusable expert lanes.
Review the team structure and memory plan.
